notes.title: The Expedition Update v1.42
notes.content: [p]Yep! The Expedition is now on Medal and now supports Auto-Clipping powered by Medal![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560812/07bfa108a78d815490f3cda7a3b52cde8bef42b0.png"][/img][/p][p](not a promotion but you should download medal!)[/p][h2][b]CHANGES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added Auto-Clipping in the some scenarios:[/p][list][*][p]Player Death[/p][/*][*][p]Chase Ends[/p][/*][*][p]Jumpscares[/p][/*][*][p] Endings[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added "The Expedition" on Medal (thanks to the support team!)[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]FIXES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the Ladder on the last level's material not setting properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs relating to interactions[/p][/*][/list][p]Theres not too much else aside from some backend optimizations, due to the fact im working on quite a lot at the moment :)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v1.12 Version out!!
notes.content: [p][b]I'm glad to announce that the new The Expedition update is live right now![/b][/p][p]the new update adds content and also fixed some bugs that were too long lived.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Added Main Menu (by extension extras menu, status, random camera positions etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 Achievements (Fell of the path & a secret achievement)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Tutorial when you first start the game[/p][/*][*][p]Made the chests more biased towards giving you batteries[/p][/*][*][p]Made the chests 1 second search time instead of 2 seconds[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed first ten soft-lock death loop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed second ending killing player randomly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several movement issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could somehow clip out of bounds in the first area[/p][/*][*][p]Several other fixes i cant remember ;-;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Shoutout to ma boy [url="https://www.twitch.tv/ejahmix" style="button"]Ejahmix [/url]for playing my game[/p][p](go follow him he's an underrated streamer)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560812/a31b8470d0928219c0a484e23aa4691c21d44326.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also, check the extras tab ;)[/p]

notes.title: Thanks!!!
notes.content: [p]Thank you all so much for the first month of release, its been great![/p][p][/p][p]I understand that there are several bugs including:[/p][list][*][p]Death Loop with the first area the player can die[/p][/*][*][p]Inability to access the second ending of the game[/p][/*][/list][p]Please note i have been working on fixing these issues and will have a new fix soon!!![/p][p][/p][p]thanks so much for everything!!![/p][p][/p]
